finalText:
Found it. `processOrder.js` grabbed a connection with `pool.acquire()` but released it only on success — no `try/finally`. Every bad order (`invalid order payload`) leaked one connection permanently. The worker log shows exactly that: a run of validation failures around 2:06am, then `pool exhausted: no connections available` right after — that's your 2am page.

`handleRequest` was already safe since it goes through the `withConnection` wrapper, but `processOrder` skipped it on purpose (comment said it used to hold the connection across a retry loop). I wrapped its release in `try/finally` so it always runs, retry loop or not.

All 4 tests pass now.
